heroHeadline: Lebanon-Israel Ceasefire Violated Again May 18 (5 Killed); Trump Convenes Iran Situation Room; Colombia's Total Peace Faces May 31 Election Test
heroSubtitle: May 18, 2026 — one day after the 45-day Lebanon-Israel ceasefire extension formally entered force, Israel launched fresh airstrikes on southern Lebanon killing at least 5 and wounding 15, continuing a pattern of 10,000+ documented violations (UNIFIL) since April 16; the security track opens at the Pentagon May 29. On Iran, President Trump convened a top-level Situation Room meeting with national security principals as the nuclear deadlock deepens — no new US-Iran round is scheduled, the Hormuz blockade enters its 11th week (~750 vessels trapped, $6B/month blocked), and Iranian FM Araghchi has declared Tehran 'doubts US seriousness'; the EU3 Istanbul track continues as Tehran's diplomatic hedge. Ukraine-Russia remains at complete impasse after the Istanbul collapse (May 16), with full-scale war resumed along the 1,000-km front. In Gaza, the Hamas disarmament deadlock persists despite Hamas's May 17 indirect-talks signal; IDF controls 50%+ of the Strip. A critical electoral juncture: Colombia's presidential election on May 31 — just 13 days away — will determine whether Total Peace survives or is dismantled, as Crisis Group warns of divergent paths (Cepeda, Valencia, or De la Espriella). One positive development continues in DRC: M23's Ruzizi Plain withdrawal (confirmed May 14-17) is the first territorial concession since the December 2025 Washington Accords, though Rwanda remains 'deeply disappointing' per US assessment.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN, African Union, IGAD, Crisis Group, USIP, PA-X Database, and Tier 1–3 sources across all media poles.
